   - GST registration certificate (received — good)

   - We require a vendor-facing note with the UEN and "Goods exported — zero-rated under GST" when tax = 0.

Once signed and we have the above confirmation that shipments are zero-rated exports, Karthik and Lauren will validate tax routing and flip the PO to active. Monica — looping you for any legal/tax flags on zero-rated export evidence.
